description: Instructions for content formatting gallery commands with parameter variants (fonts, colors, styles, lists, spacing, borders, shading, text effects, underlines, case changes, and drop caps).

BordersSelectionGallery.apply_bottom_border: Add a bottom border to the paragraph containing 'Target'.
BordersSelectionGallery.apply_top_border: Add a top border to the paragraph containing 'Target'.

BulletsGalleryWord.apply_checkmark: Apply bullet list formatting to all paragraphs using checkmark bullets (✓).
BulletsGalleryWord.apply_hollow_circle: Apply bullet list formatting to all paragraphs using hollow circle bullets (○).
BulletsGalleryWord.apply_solid_circle: Apply bullet list formatting to all paragraphs using solid circle bullets (●).
BulletsGalleryWord.apply_solid_square: Apply bullet list formatting to all paragraphs using solid square bullets (■).

ChangeCaseGallery.apply_Capitalize_Each_Word: Capitalize each word in the text 'alpha target omega.'
ChangeCaseGallery.apply_Sentence_case: Apply sentence case to the text 'alpha target omega.'
ChangeCaseGallery.apply_tOGGLE_cASE: Toggle the case of the word 'Target'.

Font.apply_Arial: Change the font of the word 'Target' to Arial.
Font.apply_Comic_Sans: Change the font of the word 'Target' to Comic Sans MS.

FontColorPicker.apply_Red: Change the font color of the word 'Target' to red (RGB: 255, 0, 0).
FontColorPicker.apply_Yellow: Change the font color of the word 'Target' to yellow.

FontSize.apply_18pt: Change the font size of the word 'Target' to 18 points.
FontSize.apply_32pt: Change the font size of the word 'Target' to 32 points.
FontSize.apply_40pt: Change the font size of the word 'Target' to 40 points.
FontSize.apply_8pt: Change the font size of the word 'Target' to 8 points.

LigatureGalleryWord.apply_Standard: Apply standard ligatures to all text.

LineSpacingGallery.apply_1_15: Set the line spacing of all paragraphs in the document to 1.15 lines.
LineSpacingGallery.apply_1_5: Set the line spacing of all paragraphs in the document to 1.5 lines.
LineSpacingGallery.apply_Double: Set the line spacing of all paragraphs in the document to double (2 lines).
LineSpacingGallery.apply_Triple: Set the line spacing of all paragraphs in the document to triple (3 lines).

ListLevelGallery.apply_level_1: Change the list level of the third paragraph ('Second sub-item') to level 1 (outermost level).
ListLevelGallery.apply_level_2: Change the list level of the third paragraph ('Second sub-item') to level 2 (first sub-level).
ListLevelGallery.apply_level_4: Change the list level of the third paragraph ('Second sub-item') to level 4 (third sub-level).
ListLevelGallery.apply_level_5: Change the list level of the third paragraph ('Second sub-item') to level 5 (fourth sub-level).

MultilevelListGallery.apply_arabic_paren_nested: Apply multilevel list formatting to all paragraphs using nested Arabic numerals/letters with closing parentheses (1) a) i).
MultilevelListGallery.apply_article_section: Apply multilevel list formatting to all paragraphs using Article/Section style (Article I. Section 1.01 (a)).
MultilevelListGallery.apply_bullet_multilevel: Apply multilevel list formatting to all paragraphs using bullet symbols.
MultilevelListGallery.apply_decimal_outline: Apply multilevel list formatting to all paragraphs using decimal outline numbering (1. 1.1. 1.1.1.).

NumberingGalleryWord.apply_arabic_paren: Apply numbered list formatting to all paragraphs using Arabic numerals with closing parenthesis (1) 2) 3).
NumberingGalleryWord.apply_arabic_period: Apply numbered list formatting to all paragraphs using Arabic numerals with period (1. 2. 3.).
NumberingGalleryWord.apply_uppercase_letter_period: Apply numbered list formatting to all paragraphs using uppercase letters with period (A. B. C.).
NumberingGalleryWord.apply_uppercase_roman_period: Apply numbered list formatting to all paragraphs using uppercase Roman numerals with period (I. II. III.).

QuickStylesGallery.apply_Heading_1: Apply the 'Heading 1' style to the heading text.
QuickStylesGallery.apply_Title: Apply the 'Title' style to the heading text.

ShadingColorPicker.apply_Green: Apply bright green background shading (RGB: 0, 255, 0) to the word 'Target'.
ShadingColorPicker.apply_Yellow: Apply yellow background shading to the word 'Target'.

StylisticSetsMenuWord.apply_Elaborate_Flourishes: Transform the text into elaborate decorative calligraphy with dramatic swashes and flourishes.

TextFillGradientGallery.apply_diagonal_up: Apply a diagonal gradient fill to the word 'Target' (color transitions from bottom-left to top-right).
TextFillGradientGallery.apply_horizontal: Make the word 'Target' appear to fade from red (on the left) to black (on the right).
TextFillGradientGallery.apply_vertical: Make the word 'Target' appear to fade from red (at the top) to black (at the bottom).

TextHighlightColorPicker.apply_Blue: Apply blue highlight to the word 'Target'.
TextHighlightColorPicker.apply_Yellow: Apply yellow highlight to the word 'Target'.

TextOutlineColorPickerAlternate.apply_Blue: Change the text outline color of the word 'Target' to blue (RGB: 0, 0, 255).
TextOutlineColorPickerAlternate.apply_Yellow: Change the text outline color of the word 'Target' to yellow.

TextOutlineDashesGallery.apply_Dash: Apply a dashed line tracing the edge of each letter in the word 'Target'.
TextOutlineDashesGallery.apply_Round_Dot: Apply a round-dot dotted line tracing the edge of each letter in the word 'Target'.

TextOutlineWeightGallery.apply_1pt: Set the text outline weight of the word 'Target' to 1 point.
TextOutlineWeightGallery.apply_2pt: Set the text outline weight of the word 'Target' to 2 points.
TextOutlineWeightGallery.apply_3pt: Set the text outline weight of the word 'Target' to 3 points.

TextReflectionGallery.apply_type_1: Apply reflection effect type 1 (tight reflection touching) to the word 'Target'.
TextReflectionGallery.apply_type_3: Apply reflection effect type 3 (full reflection touching) to the word 'Target'.
TextReflectionGallery.apply_type_5: Apply reflection effect type 5 (half reflection 4pt offset) to the word 'Target'.
TextReflectionGallery.apply_type_7: Apply reflection effect type 7 (tight reflection 8pt offset) to the word 'Target'.
TextReflectionGallery.apply_type_9: Apply reflection effect type 9 (full reflection 8pt offset) to the word 'Target'.

UnderlineColorPicker.apply_Red: Change the underline color of the word 'Target' to red (RGB: 255, 0, 0).
UnderlineColorPicker.apply_Yellow: Change the underline color of the word 'Target' to yellow.

UnderlineGallery.apply_Dash: Apply dashed underline (╌╌╌) to the word 'Target'.
UnderlineGallery.apply_Dotted: Apply dotted underline (⋯⋯⋯) to the word 'Target'.
UnderlineGallery.apply_Double: Apply double underline (═══) to the word 'Target'.
UnderlineGallery.apply_Single: Apply single underline to the text 'Target Omega' (continuous line under all characters including the space).
UnderlineGallery.apply_Words: Apply words-only underline to the text 'Target Omega' (underline appears under each word but NOT under the space between them).

DropCapInsertGallery.dropped: Apply drop cap style 'Dropped' to the first paragraph.
DropCapInsertGallery.in_margin: Apply drop cap style 'In Margin' to the first paragraph.
